# Surgent LCP (Surgent Life Care Planning)

> Surgeon-authored life care planning and medical expert services for
> attorneys. Board-certified practicing surgeons who are also Certified Life
> Care Planners prepare litigation-ready life care plans, medical cost
> projections, independent medical examinations, causation opinions, and
> expert testimony for personal injury, medical malpractice, and catastrophic
> injury cases across the United States.

## Services

- [All Services](https://www.surgentlcp.com/services/): Life care plans, medical cost projections, IMEs, causation opinions, billing analysis, record review, and expert consultation — every engagement authored by a board-certified surgeon
- [Request a Plan](https://www.surgentlcp.com/request-a-plan/): Case consultation intake — response within one business day

## About

- [About Surgent LCP](https://www.surgentlcp.com/about/): Why surgeon authorship matters — credentials, principles, and the standard behind every opinion
